description: Search free-to-enter US sweepstakes listed on UltimateSweepers.com, sorted by end date by default. Every result links to its UltimateSweepers listing with official rules, eligibility and the entry link.

ending.description: Only sweepstakes ending within this window.

limit.description: Number of results (default and max 10). Narrow the search to see others.

min_prize_usd.description: Minimum total prize value in US dollars.

query.description: Words to match in the title, sponsor or prize, e.g. 'disney trip' or 'pepsi'.

sort.description: Sort order. Default: ending soonest first.

state.description: Two-letter US state code; hides sweepstakes that exclude that state.

name: search_sweepstakes
title: Search sweepstakes
